meta.name: add-opencode
meta.description: Use OpenCode as an agent provider. OpenRouter, OpenAI, Google, DeepSeek, etc. via OpenCode config — not the Anthropic Agent SDK. Per group via `ncl groups config update --provider opencode`; host passes OPENCODE_* and XDG mount when spawning containers.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 让编码智能体通过 OpenCode 调用不同大模型。
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果你正在搭建编码智能体,并希望它们通过 OpenCode 使用多家模型。
copy.tagline_en: Make your coding agents call multiple LLMs through OpenCode.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you are building coding agents and want them to use multiple LLMs through OpenCode.

howto.what: 把 OpenCode 接成 NanoClaw 的 agent provider:复制 provider 文件、注册 barrel、装依赖并重建容器镜像;之后可按代理组把 provider 切成 opencode,用 OpenRouter、DeepSeek 等模型跑。
howto.when: 当你要求把某个 agent 组的模型提供方换成 OpenCode,而不是默认的 claude,或要接 OpenRouter、DeepSeek 等第三方模型时触发。

say.text: 把这个代理组的 provider 换成 opencode
帮我用 OpenRouter 的 claude-sonnet-4 跑这个组
say.note: 需先在 .env 与 OneCLI 配好密钥

say.text: 这个组改用 DeepSeek 作模型提供方

howto.what_en: Adds OpenCode as a NanoClaw agent provider: copies provider files, wires barrels, installs deps and rebuilds the container image; then you switch a group's provider to opencode to run OpenRouter, DeepSeek etc.
howto.when_en: When you want an agent group to run on OpenCode instead of the default claude provider, or to use OpenRouter, DeepSeek etc. as the model backend.

say_en.text: Switch this agent group's provider to opencode
Run this group on OpenRouter's claude-sonnet-4
say_en.note: Set .env and register the key first

say_en.text: Use DeepSeek as this group's model provider
say_en.note: Set OPENCODE_MODEL to a deepseek model id
